description: Declarative host-agent workflow; no automatic scheduler or tool transport.
required_outputs: CMS handoff and post-change measurement plan
stop_conditions: Non-indexed/canonicalized page → investigate that technical condition before spending on a long rewrite.
Two pages compete for one intent → propose consolidation review; do not delete/redirect either with unavailable tools.
No verified firsthand evidence → use researched wording and remove invented tested/visited claims.
